headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of October 22, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 22.93%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 12.74%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 10.19%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 40.01%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has seen a slight decline of 2.84%. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during times of market volatility and uncertainty. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
